description: NIC firmware 28.42.1000 -> 28.43.1014 on ORION backend NICs (validated bundle B-2026.10).

metric_definitions.busbw_GBps: per-rail bus bandwidth, GB/s: 2-node (16-GPU, all 8 rails) all_reduce_perf busbw at 8 GiB divided by 8, compared with the 50 GB/s per-rail line rate; pair test with a fixed reference node
metric_definitions.cnp_rx_per_s: RoCE congestion notification packets received per second, summed over 8 backend NICs
metric_definitions.link_flaps: backend link down/up transitions in the sample interval
metric_definitions.pfc_pause_rx_per_s: PFC pause frames received on priority 3 per second, summed over 8 backend NICs
metric_definitions.xid_events: GPU Xid events in the sample interval
